# Iris "Merged Spirit Magi" — Spirit Magus skills in Active Skill slots (soft-invalidation gating)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Spirit Magus skills (Spirit Magus-tagged)
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, slot-gating, soft-invalidation, trigger

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game (the engine-level plumbing is covered by tests, but the game-text reading below is not measured).

Two Iris base traits carry the identical enabling clause "When a Spirit Magus Skill is set as an Active Skill, casting the Active Skill is considered as casting the Trait Skill as well": **Vigilant Breeze** (`_hero_traits.json:4725-4736`, trait_id `vigilant_breeze`) and **Growing Breeze** (`_hero_traits.json:1720-1731` and repeated at level entries :1743,:1755,:1767,:1779,:1784, trait_id `growing_breeze`). These are two independent, mutually-exclusive Iris base-trait picks; owner reports both work in-game (not independently sourced beyond that report).

**Both traits are now wired (prior gap closed).** `computeSkillSlotEligibility` (`src/renderer/src/api/client.ts:2067,2130`) checks trait-id membership against `MERGED_SPIRIT_MAGI_TRAIT_IDS = new Set(['vigilant_breeze', 'growing_breeze'])` via `.has(traitId)`, so `spiritMagusActiveEligible` is now `true` for either selected trait — matching the owner's report that both grant the active-slot exemption. (An earlier build wired `vigilant_breeze` only; that gap is fixed as of this entry.) `skillSlotEligibility.test.ts:241-245` (`describe('Iris Merged Spirit Magi — both base traits widen spiritMagusActiveEligible')`) is a dedicated `growing_breeze` test: it asserts `spiritMagusActiveEligible` is `true` for the `growing_breeze` trait id AND that `computeInvalidSkillSlots` returns `[]` for a Spirit Magus skill placed in an active slot under that trait (the exact regression the widened `Set` was meant to fix). `vigilant_breeze` is separately covered at :247-251. Both trait ids now have passing dedicated coverage — the widened behavior no longer rests on code inspection alone.

"Merged Spirit Magi" is the in-game noun for the merged form (glossary id 80010 "Vigilant", `_hero_traits.json:4909-4912": "Allows you to control Spirit Magi and attack enemies with Spirit Magus Skills... All skills except for the second skill are switched with Spirit Magus Skills...").
